# Ability Score and Modifier

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#AbilityScoreandModifier)*

A creature has six ability scores—Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma—each of which has a corresponding modifier. Add the modifier when you make a [D20 Test](D20-Test.md) with the corresponding ability or when a rule asks you to do so. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[The Six Abilities](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#TheSixAbilities)").
